data.one_liner: A plugin for handling the Vibration API on iOS, Android, web, and OpenHarmony.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to trigger device vibrations with custom durations, patterns, intensities, amplitudes, sharpness, and predefined presets. It also allows checking for vibration capabilities and amplitude control support.
use_when: You need to trigger tactile feedback or vibration patterns on mobile or web devices.
You want to use predefined vibration presets for common alerts and notifications.
avoid_when: You only need standard UI haptic feedback handled automatically by Flutter's HapticFeedback class.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, and OpenHarmony.
Provides granular control over vibration duration, patterns, intensities, and amplitude.
Includes a rich set of vibration presets.
weaknesses: Amplitude and custom vibration controls depend heavily on OS version and hardware capabilities.
Requires manual native permission configuration for Android and OpenHarmony.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the VIBRATE permission to AndroidManifest.xml and/or module.json5 for OpenHarmony.
